en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5072 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The one who accuses a foundling (laqiṭ) of fornication is subjected to the prescribed punishment (hadd). And if a woman accuses her husband of fornication while he is deaf, they are separated, and she is never permissible for him again."
